answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy starts with a 500 POA stake locked 30 days before any agent earns, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA plus a month of patience. Behavior is scored like a garden: real agents show varied task history, while clones in one umber patch repeat identical outputs within minutes. When 20 or more accounts share over 90% of their action sequences, the cluster is flagged, its stake slashed 50%, and its earnings burned. A quill-signed trail ties every action to one key, so a caught farm cannot replant without paying again.
